name: Tonfas
author: RaintDM
entries: Originally designed by the engineers of Mezeporta, Tonfas are twin weapons propelled by internal steam mechanisms. They grant unprecedented aerial agility and the ability to accumulate pressure with every impact, only to release it later in a devastating explosion. They are complex tools that demand a constant rhythm—dancing between agile evasions and planting your feet to deliver bone-crushing blows.

rows: Mastery Note (Nick), Spirit Gauge, Tonfa Styles, Spirit Burst
Spirit Gauge Upgrade I, Spirit Burst Upgrade I, Sky Step
Spirit Gauge Upgrade II, Spirit Burst Upgrade II, Earth Impact
Spirit Gauge Upgrade III, Fast Spirit Charge, Sky Dash
Spirit Gauge Upgrade IV, Spirit Burst Upgrade III, Style Master, Apex Spirit

customFeatures.name: Mastery Note (Nick)
customFeatures.description: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Gauge
customFeatures.description: The weapon builds up internal pressure through combat. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, you gain 1 Spirit Charge (up to the maximum of 2). You lose all accumulated charges if you spend 1 minute out of combat or without making an attack.

customFeatures.name: Tonfa Styles
customFeatures.description:
Tonfas feature a mechanism that alters their center of gravity. You can use your Bonus Action to change your Tonfa style. Once you choose a style, you remain in it until you decide to change it again or ending as free action:

• Sky Style: The weapon flows with your movements, and short bursts from the thrusters allow you to glide over obstacles. While in this stance, you ignore difficult terrain, and moving through a hostile creature's space does not cost you extra movement.
• Earth Style: The weight and pressure shift to the striking ends. The weapon's damage die increases to 1d10, but the massive recoil is so heavy that your walking speed is halved while you remain in this stance.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Burst
customFeatures.description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, you can open the pressure valves. You can expend any number of Spirit Charges you currently have to add 1d4 Force damage to that attack.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Gauge Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: You can store a maximum of 3 charges.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Burst Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: Your Spirit Burst increases to 1d6 Force damage per charge expended.

customFeatures.name: Sky Step
customFeatures.description: While in Sky Style, when you make a running or standing jump, you can expend 1 Spirit Charge to double your jump distance (both horizontal and vertical) for that jump.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Gauge Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: You can store a maximum of 4 charges.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Burst Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: Your Spirit Burst increases to 1d8 Force damage per charge expended.

customFeatures.name: Earth Impact
customFeatures.description: While in Earth Style, your critical hits transfer seismic pressure. If you score a critical hit against a creature, you can expend 1 Spirit Charge. If you do, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be knocked Prone.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Gauge Upgrade III
customFeatures.description: You can store a maximum of 5 charges.

customFeatures.name: Fast Spirit Charge
customFeatures.description: The initial friction heats up the weapon instantly. When you roll for Initiative, your Tonfas generate 2 Spirit Charges.

customFeatures.name: Sky Dash
customFeatures.description: While in Sky Style, you can use the thrusters for three-dimensional evasive maneuvers. When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, you can expend 1 Spirit Charge to use your Reaction to move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement (and only while the reaction lasts), you gain a fly speed. If you end this reaction in the air, you fall immediately unless you have another way to stay suspended.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Gauge Upgrade IV
customFeatures.description: You can store a maximum of 6 charges.

customFeatures.name: Spirit Burst Upgrade III
customFeatures.description: Your Spirit Burst increases to 1d10 Force damage per charge expended.

customFeatures.name: Style Master
customFeatures.description: Your fluidity is absolute. Changing between Sky Style and Earth Style no longer requires your Bonus Action; you can do it for free once per turn (No action required).

customFeatures.name: Apex Spirit
customFeatures.description: If you expend 5 Spirit Charges in a single Spirit Burst, the impact causes a massive implosion within the creature. In addition to the extra force damage (5d10), the target becomes Incapacitated until the end of its next turn due to neurological shock. If the creature is Large or smaller, this feature ignores any immunity to the Incapacitated condition.
